title: Integrity agreements with Walgreen Co and Medi-Lynx: what they cover
question: What do the federal integrity agreements with Walgreen Co and Medi-Lynx Cardiac Monitoring require, and do they reach San Francisco?
finding: Walgreen Co was under an integrity agreement from January 11, 2019 to July 16, 2024 (settlement $3.5 million) and signed a new one on April 18, 2025 for five years, covering its retail pharmacy operations across the United States, including controlled-substance dispensing; neither document names a San Francisco location, so the San Francisco stores are covered as part of the national retail business. Medi-Lynx Cardiac Monitoring's agreement ran from June 23, 2017 to October 5, 2022 (settlement $2.9 million) and is closed. Reportable events posted under the agreements include $512,923.78, $37,998.53, $71,595.27 in settlements with the Inspector General.
how: Read from the two agreement pages saved from the Inspector General's site and the 2025 Walgreen agreement text (29 pages): status, dates, location, settlement amounts, reportable events, and the definitions of covered functions and affiliates. San Francisco billing-number counts come from the medicaid group's agreements screen.
limits: An integrity agreement is a settlement term, not a finding of guilt; the conduct behind the 2019 and 2017 agreements was resolved by settlement, and the reportable events were self-disclosed. Nothing in these files ties the conduct to a San Francisco store or clinic.
